notes: The publisher version at IOP is bronze open access with no Creative Commons licence, and the IOP PDF path returns an anti-bot interstitial. The archived file is the KU Leuven Lirias repository copy, whose own cover sheet states: 'Archived version: Accepted author manuscript: the content is identical to the content of the published paper, but without the final typesetting by the publisher.' That is the author-accepted-manuscript case in the schema vocabulary. Because it is an accepted manuscript, page and table numbering may differ from the version of record, so the card cites section content rather than page numbers. Extraction: markitdown on a single-column accepted manuscript, which converts well; the Lirias cover sheet is the first block of source.md.
